subject: Future Tech
title: The He Jiankui Scandal
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The He Jiankui Scandal.

hook.text: In 2018, Chinese scientist He Jiankui announced he had created the world's first gene-edited babies.

buildup.text: He used CRISPR to disable the CCR5 gene in twin embryos, claiming it would protect them from HIV infection.

discovery.text: The scientific community condemned the experiment.

twist.text: He acted in secret, without proper ethics review. He was sentenced to three years in a Chinese prison for his actions.

climax.text: The scandal triggered a global moratorium discussion on heritable gene editing. No country has since approved such work.

punchline.text: One rogue experiment set the field back by years.

quiz.question: What gene did He Jiankui edit in the twin embryos?
